scope: Newsroom automation only; independent from AI Workforce Enterprise

freeResources.name: Official publisher websites
freeResources.use: Primary-source discovery; confirm domain and publication date

freeResources.name: Google News
freeResources.use: Discovery only; open and verify original publishers

freeResources.name: Wikimedia Commons
freeResources.use: Media discovery; check each asset license and attribution

freeResources.name: Openverse
freeResources.use: Creative Commons media discovery; verify license at source

modules.title: Source verification
modules.exercise: Record publisher, original URL, timestamp, evidence, and a second independent publisher or an allowlisted official source.
modules.pass: No unsupported claim is labelled verified.

modules.title: News writing
modules.exercise: Write a neutral headline, concise summary, attributed body, and separate confirmed facts from unknowns.
modules.pass: No invented quote, source, statistic, or footage.

modules.title: Visual rights
modules.exercise: Record asset origin, license, attribution, crop/edit restrictions, and consent/privacy risks.
modules.pass: No asset enters publish-ready state without rights review.

modules.title: Urdu and English quality
modules.exercise: Review names, dates, figures, transliteration, Nastaliq rendering, and meaning consistency.

modules.title: Security and privacy
modules.exercise: Check authentication boundaries, secret handling, input validation, logs, and personal-data minimization.
modules.pass: No secret or private draft is exposed.
